commits.message:
print hands "default" only to the text it sets itself; a full paragraph's last row takes its start edge (rich-control-codes-xh4n.3k9)

Review: "default" in RenderOptions reached FlexStrip and Tree children and
padded right-to-left items to the width. The paragraph level is read once per line.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

Unset justify places nothing again; Console.print asks for the paragraph's edge with "default" (rich-control-codes-xh4n.3k9)

Review: an unjustified right-to-left row padded to the width inside Strip,
Syntax, Pretty and soft-wrapped prints. "default" is now the start edge
without filling, and the start level is read off the raw line, as reorder reads it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

A right-to-left paragraph starts at its right edge by default, in text, table cells and Markdown (rich-control-codes-xh4n.3k9)

justify gains "start", the paragraph's own edge; Column and Markdown default
to it, and an unjustified right-to-left row is placed right. plain keeps its
bytes: logical order's start is the line's first character.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

decodeAnsi reads the 8-bit C1 introducers as the sequences they start (rich-control-codes-xh4n.187) (#573)

* decodeAnsi reads the 8-bit C1 introducers as the sequences they start (rich-control-codes-xh4n.187)

* An 8-bit OSC 8 is a link, a lone 8-bit string introducer costs one character, and ESC E ends a line (rich-control-codes-xh4n.187 review)

* A C1 string introducer reads as its ESC form, cut at the line's end, and ESC E's line break is derived from CONTROL_CODES (rich-control-codes-xh4n.187 review)

* A string escape's payload ends at ESC or any C1 control, as the VT500 parser ends it; one STRING_STOPS for OSC 8 and decodeAnsi (rich-control-codes-xh4n.187 review)
